preconditions.description: The number of elements in the sequence is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence is a positive integer between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.
